title: 해동하자마자 발표
scope: 실제 시작 이미지 제작만. 동작 성공·립싱크·음성 검증 없음.

pd_adjustments.note: 검지 목표는 왼쪽 사진 상단으로 통일. S01~02 서리뒤동일포즈, S03가시화, S06동작시같은점.
S04부터 열풍기는 RL 발밑 화면왼쪽. S09 동일위치 회수. 오른쪽 바닥 낡은지시 업데이트 필요.
S04~S05 사이 PR은 작업등쪽 한 걸음 이동하고 오른팔을 가슴앞으로 가로질러 등 접근. 왼손 판 유지.
S07 넓히며 RL은 작업등쪽 두 걸음 이동. S08 실제 시작영상의 조작손은 왼손. 판은 계속 PR왼손; RL빈손.
S09 왼쪽바닥에서 열풍기 잡고 RL쪽으로 걸어가는 연결을4.5초동작에 포함. 필요시 영상생성8초후편집으로호흡확보.

entries.initial_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a cinematic photoreal live-action commercial film frame, not an illustration. Dramatic cold blue-white studio, believable theatrical translucent ice with frost, expressive sincere actors. 16:9 landscape.
Character identity guide only; show only people explicitly visible in this scene. PR: a tall long-limbed Black man in his late thirties, short rounded afro, thin rectangular glasses, vivid orange insulated coverall, short burgundy scarf, black winter boots. RL: a short sturdy Korean woman in her late fifties, straight black-and-grey bob, cobalt blue padded jacket, grey snow trousers, white earmuffs. RA: a slim Korean man in his twenties with a black buzzcut, plum padded jacket, black trousers, grey gloves. F1: a South Asian woman in her forties with a long single black braid and lilac insulated coat, holding a white case board, behind the second translucent ice panel. F2: a round-built East Asian man in his sixties, bald, navy insulated coat, holding a green case board, behind the third translucent ice panel. Cold artificial studio, low-angle medium-wide. PR holds a rigid white comparison board in his LEFT hand angled forward at chest height behind the front ice panel. His extended RIGHT index points five centimeters from a specific spot in the board's upper-right photo area. Dense frost hides the BOARD and target while the reaching hand silhouette is visible. Both hands and board must stay in this exact pose through thaw. A fixed four-centimeter ivory tab hangs from its lower-right edge behind frost. RL holds powered-off blower in right hand; RA prepares blanket. Existing two rear panel edges and bench remain. Single cinematic still, landscape 16:9, a real start frame BEFORE the specified action, never its completed outcome. No captions, no legible lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no collage, no extra people or limbs. Keep specified caption area quiet. Only depict characters explicitly present in the scene; identity guide is not a request to add cast.
Space lock: one front vertical ice panel centered, two rear vertical panels behind to camera-right with only edges visible. A low grey sturdy rescue bench in front center, an upright black adjustable work lamp at camera-right pointing toward the presenter's face, closed grey equipment chest camera-left. Main presenter behind front ice at center; rescue leader to camera-left, assistant to camera-right. Yellow compact handheld heat blower. Ivory wool rescue blanket folded in assistant's arms. Frost should hide the board's contents and pointed target, not completely hide the presenter's vivid orange silhouette. No injured or frightened person; his apparent urgency is intent concentration. Keep lower eighteen percent calm floor, full width composition. The white board, hidden behind frost, is landscape, two side-by-side unlettered photos of the same red triangular solid and two blank condition rectangles, small ivory fabric tab at viewer's lower-right.
